{{Quote|I am the Miskara of the Vagaari people. ''[&hellip;]'' You will address me as ''Your Eminence''. I'm told you have the insolence to demand that I bargain with you.|27 BBY's Miskara, to Jorj Car'das|translated=1|<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
'''Miskara''' was the [[Politics/Legends|ruler]] of the nomadic [[Vagaari Empire]] who lead the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and their [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].

==History==
During a battle against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;a group of peacekeepers&mdash;aboard the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]], the Miskara was killed, and the [[Vagaari slaver fleet]] fled.<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> By [[23 ABY]], another [[Unidentified Miskara (Yuuzhan Vong)|Miskara]] made contact with the "Far Outsiders,"<ref name="TUR" /> the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species,<ref name="TERC" /> and helped them plan their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. After the invasion, the Vagaari Empire captured territories formerly owned by those killed by the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="TUR" />

==Style of office==
{{Quote|You do not speak in the presence of the Miskara until spoken to,|A guard|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
A Vagaari was the [[Unidentified Miskara (Jorj Car'das)|Miskara]], who was addressed to as "Your Eminence" and [[Battle for Outbound Flight|traveled]] somewhere near the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Crustai system/Legends|Crustai system]] after [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] provided [[Gender/Legends|him]] with the location of a [[Crustai asteroid base|base]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

===Eligibility===
To become the Miskara, a candidate required the support of a significant cadre and had to [[Death/Legends|murder]] the reigning Miskara. Once the leader was killed, the cadre became the new aristocracy.<ref name="TUR" /> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref>
